summary: Intraday snapshot for 2026-11-06: the fact layer was generated at 17:50Z, which is 12:50 ET, so every US equity and sector figure here is a live session print rather than a close, while the A-share block still describes the 2026-11-05 session. The risk score is 70.82, high_risk and risk_off, 0.58 below the 2026-11-05 row at 71.40, but the near-flat headline hides a large internal reallocation. The volatility dimension went from 43.18 to 72.72 and supplied 4.43 points, because the 2026-11-05 VIX close of 28.18 finally entered the model against a prior print of 16.61. Two dimensions absorbed that gain: cross-asset confirmation fell from a near-saturated 0.875 to 0.625, subtracting 3.75 points as SPY turned positive at 0.4366 and gold turned negative at 1.145; equity structure fell from 81.20 to 71.68, subtracting 1.90, as the 63-session new low share normalised from 0.5096 to 0.1019 and breadth rose from 0.2516 to 0.2774, or 43 of 155 names. The tape is an AI-hardware rebound: 17 up and 5 down out of 22 sector and theme rows, mean 2.1407, led by quantum computing at 10.0505, semiconductor equipment at 5.5825 and robotics at 4.1065, with AMD at 7.9167, MU at 4.0174 and NVDA at 2.3128. Credit is the one input that moved against the tape, high yield OAS widening from 3.32 to 3.48, which lifted liquidity and credit from 74.74 to 78.19.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Volatility is the day's largest single move, from 43.18 to 72.72, worth 4.43 points of the score. VIX closed the 2026-11-05 session at 28.18 against 16.61 the day before, a 69.66 percent jump that puts the input at the 92.62 percentile, while 20 day realised volatility sits at 19.9942. The dimension had been reading the 2026-11-04 print of 16.61 for a full session, with an indicator score of only 39.76, so this is a vintage catch-up rather than a fresh shock.

Cross-asset confirmation fell from 0.875 to 0.625, removing 3.75 points, the largest offset of the day. Two legs turned off as the tape improved: SPY at 0.4366 and gold at 1.145. Of the 5 legs that still fire, 3 are standing levels that do not respond to the tape: the dollar index at 121.6656 against a 105 threshold, the real rate at 2.64 against 1.5, and small caps 4.2096 behind over 63 sessions, plus bitcoin 0.49691 lower and copper 0.104 lower.

Rates remain the structural floor under the score. The 10 year real rate holds 2.64 at the 97.91 percentile and the nominal 10 year sits at 4.90 at the 96.63 percentile, with the curve at 0.32; macro is 73.98 and the real rate alone contributes 4.8955 points. The block rolled from the 2026-11-03 print of 4.95 to 2026-11-04 at 4.90, costing 0.02 points of the score, so this is a level problem rather than a tape problem.

Credit is the one input that moved against the tape. High yield OAS widened from 3.32 to 3.48 and investment grade from 0.91 to 0.93, lifting liquidity and credit from 74.74 to 78.19 and adding 0.69 points. The level is still far below the 4 threshold that would trigger the widening signal, so this is drift inside a benign band, not a credit event.

Equity structure improved but remains the second highest dimension at 71.68. The 63-session new low share collapsed from 0.5096 to 0.1019, or 16 of 157 names, and breadth above the 200 day average rose from 0.2516 to 0.2774, or 43 of 155. New highs stay thin at 0.0318, or 5 of 157, and semiconductors remain 19.1292 points behind over 63 sessions.

supporting_signals.claim: The rebound is broad rather than a single-name squeeze: 17 up and 5 down out of 22 sector and theme rows, mean 2.1407, with the leadership in hardware, quantum computing at 10.0505, semiconductor equipment at 5.5825, robotics at 4.1065 and networking at 3.7202. The bounce is still far smaller than the weekly damage: NVDA 2.3128, AMD 7.9167, MU 4.0174 and TSLA 3.8901 are still 9.2064, 13.5469, 22.8293 and 10.6926 percent lower over the week.

SPY is still 0.7959 percent above its 200 day average and 5.5051 percent below its 52 week high, with 3 month momentum at 4.7644 below zero. That is why the trend dimension barely moved, from 57.97 to 57.71, and why the drawdown has not become a trend break.

The absolute credit level is not yet a stress signal: high yield OAS at 3.48 is 0.16 wider than the 3.32 print but still 0.52 below the 4 threshold. On a level basis the funding market has not confirmed Thursday's equity move.

contradicting_signals.claim: Breadth argues against the risk_off label: within the same session the 63-session new low share fell from 0.5096 to 0.1019 and the share above the 200 day average rose from 0.2516 to 0.2774, while VIX printed 28.18. If that improvement holds into the next session, the 0.35 breadth gate stops binding and the regime call loses its justification even at an unchanged score.

2 of the 8 confirmation legs stopped firing as the tape turned, which is why the dimension fell from 87.50 to 62.50 and dragged 3.75 points out of the score. SPY at 0.4366 and gold at 1.145 are the flips; the other 5 legs are unchanged.

The labour data contradicts the recession leg of the risk_off read: the 2026-11-06 payroll print came in at 165 thousand with unemployment at 4.1 from 4.2, and the prior two months were revised up to 60 and 186 from 29 and 133. None of those inputs enters the score, so a strong labour print cannot lift the risk number, but it does undercut the idea that Thursday's de-rating was macro-driven.

what_changed_today: The layer was generated at 17:50Z, which is 12:50 ET, so the US cash session is still open: every US equity, sector and theme number above is an intraday print rather than a close, and nothing here describes a completed 2026-11-06 session.

The score moved only 0.58 but the composition moved far more: volatility supplied 4.43 and liquidity and credit 0.69, against 3.75 from cross-asset, 1.90 from equity structure, 0.02 from macro and 0.03 from trend. The arithmetic sums to 0.58 and is asserted against the published rows for 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06.

What landed in this refresh: VIX for 2026-11-05 at 28.18, high yield OAS at 3.48 and the payroll block, while the rates block is still the 2026-11-04 print and the dollar index is still 2026-10-30, so the 10 year at 4.90 carries no post-payroll move.

The A-share block did not advance. The 2026-11-06 daily bars arrived with a null close and were dropped by the collector, so the 11 names still carry the 2026-11-05 session, 7 up and 4 down with a mean of 0.1658. No 2026-11-06 CN close exists in this layer.
watch_next: CPI on 2026-11-10 at 13:30Z is the next test of the macro floor, with the 10 year at 4.90 and the real rate at 2.64; a hot print pushes both percentiles further into the top decile.
Whether VIX holds near 28.18: the volatility dimension at 72.72 is 15 percent of the score, so a print back near 16.61 would give back most of today's 4.43 point gain without any equity move.

Credit is the highest-leverage falsifier: high yield OAS at 3.48 needs 0.52 to reach the 4 threshold on the widening signal, and that single move would lift liquidity and credit and cross-asset together.

The AI funding channel: CoreWeave bond yields above 16 percent and the Microsoft unwind of Oracle AI capacity are the first signs that the de-rating is reaching the financing leg rather than the demand leg. Data centres at 2.4102 are the row to watch.

NVDA on 2026-11-17, with semiconductors 19.1292 points behind over 63 sessions: that positioning gap is the largest single-name event risk in the index, and it arrives with the volatility dimension already at 72.72.

bull_case.title: Bull case: volatility mean-reverts below 20
points: VIX 28.18 is the 2026-11-05 print and the tape has already turned: SPY 0.4366, AMD 7.9167 and MU 4.0174. If the fear gauge follows the tape back under 20, the volatility dimension gives back most of 4.43 points and the score returns toward the 2026-11-04 level of 64.07.
Breadth already improved, from 0.2516 to 0.2774, and the 63-session new low share from 0.5096 to 0.1019. Above 0.35 the risk_off gate stops binding.
Credit never confirmed at the level: 3.48 is still 0.52 below the 4 threshold, so the whole episode can be read as valuation compression rather than a solvency repricing.

base_case.title: Base case: the score holds in the 65 to 75 band
points: The score is 70.82 with confidence at 0.9438 and all 7 input datasets fresh, so the reading is unusually well supported for a high_risk state.
The two offsets behind today's flat print, cross-asset at 62.50 and equity structure at 71.68, are both 1 session old, so neither can be treated as a trend yet.
The rates block is 1 session stale at 4.90, so the macro dimension at 73.98 is more likely to be revised than to move on its own.

bear_case.title: Bear case: credit confirms and the score clears 75
points: A move through 4 on high yield OAS would add 0.52 of level to a dimension already at 78.19, and it would re-trigger the widening leg inside cross-asset at 62.50 in the same session.
The 63-session new low share at 0.1019 is the series with the most room to reverse; a return toward 0.5096 would take equity structure back above its 81.20 level and add roughly 1.90 points.
VIX at 28.18 is 8.18 above the 20 line that separates the risk_on branch, so any second shock would land on a dimension already at the 92.62 percentile.
